policy: ADR 0003. Synthetic (AI-authored) task sets are development fixtures and are never part of the main model comparison. Main-comparison candidates are established external benchmarks, referenced by pinned upstream revision and scored by their upstream evaluator. Nothing is 'admitted' until the protocol is frozen by an ADR.

datasets.provenance: Tranche v1-initial: upstage-cli PR #11 (merged 2026-10-29). Tranche v1-dataset: one row (bv1-tr1-json-field) kept from upstage-cli PR #12 (closed unmerged; korean-agent-bench#1, ADR 0007). Authored with an AI coding assistant, then audited (harness/docs/BENCHMARK_V1_SEMANTIC_AUDIT.md, BENCHMARK_V1_DATASET.md). No independent human review.
datasets.notes: Harness regression fixtures: 15 rows / 12 independent families / 2 language pairs (node bin/benchmark.mjs report). See BENCHMARK_V1_DATASET.md for what was dropped and why.

datasets.provenance: upstage-cli PR #10 (merged 2026-10-26); used by the live 4x4 pilot (harness/docs/PILOT_REPORT.md).
datasets.notes: Compatibility/feasibility only. The pilot report itself states it is not a benchmark.
fix-flaky-test.yaml is the CI smoke task.

datasets.status: admitted: official pipeline validated offline and in four pilot rounds on disjoint ids; main comparison frozen by ADR 0011

source.name: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL)
source.revisionNote: Verified 2026-10-29: most recent commit touching berkeley-function-call-leaderboard/ (2026-03-23); bfcl-eval 2026.3.23 was uploaded to PyPI the same minute. Unchanged from the first recording.

evaluation.upstreamEvaluator: bfcl_eval `bfcl evaluate` (AST checker for single-turn categories, relevance/irrelevance checkers, multi-turn state/response checker)
evaluation.taskIdentity: Upstream category + entry id are kept verbatim; no renumbering, filtering or rewriting without a recorded, reasoned subset definition.

openQuestions: Korean: BFCL is English. Any Korean variant is a derived condition and must be reported separately (ADR 0003).
Excluded categories (memory, web_search, multi_turn_long_context, multi_turn_miss_*) need their own decision before inclusion.
datasets.officialEvaluationCompatibility: upstream-compatible: bfcl-eval's own generate (OpenAICompletionsHandler, FC mode) and evaluate; local models registered through MODEL_CONFIG_MAPPING; subset scored with --partial-eval (upstream warns that partial scores differ from the leaderboard). No overall score is computed.

acquisition.method: Data ships inside the pinned bfcl-eval wheel; benchmarks/setup.sh downloads it and verifies the wheel sha256 before installing.

excludedCategories.format_sensitivity: Not applicable: bfcl-eval skips it for every function-calling (FC) model (_llm_response_generation.py).
excludedCategories.web_search: Needs a SerpAPI key and outbound search requests (multi_turn_eval/func_source_code/web_search.py).
excludedCategories.memory: Its vector backend loads the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding model at import (memory_vector.py), i.e. a model download; not validated here.
excludedCategories.multi_turn_long_context: Designed for long contexts; exceeds the 8192-token context validated for Solar Open 2. Deferred to a separate, explicitly long-context condition, decided before any model run.
excludedCategories.multi_turn_miss_func: Deferred: resource bound for v1 (multi-turn entries take many requests). Decided before any model run.

subset.method: Per category, rank upstream entry ids by sha256(seed + ':' + id) and keep the first min(n, category size). Inputs are upstream ids only; no model output is read.

datasets.transformation: None to data, prompts or ground truth. Tool names with '.' become '_' (upstream behaviour for OpenAI-style FC; underscore_to_dot=True maps them back in the checker). Temperature is BFCL's default (0.001), not the vendor sampling used by the harness; no max_tokens is sent (upstream semantics, ADR 0011). exaone/exaone-nothink send chat_template_kwargs {enable_thinking} via extra_body (declared adapter, benchmarks/bfcl/kab_bfcl.py).
datasets.contaminationRisk: BFCL data has been public since 2024 (live categories are user-contributed and also public). Any of the four models may have seen it in training; results are conditional on that and are not presented as contamination-free.
datasets.redistribution: Apache-2.0 (repository). Small result/score files containing BFCL prompts are committed as validation evidence under that license.

datasets.status: admitted: official evaluator validated offline; agent path validated in four pilot rounds on disjoint instances; main comparison frozen by ADR 0011 with nested stages (stages-v1.json)

source.name: SWE-bench Verified
source.revisionNote: Verified 2026-10-29: HF dataset sha unchanged since the first recording (lastModified 2026-08-16). The older princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Verified is a different repository; not used.
source.evaluatorRevisionNote: swebench==5.0.2 (PyPI; untagged commit 'Release 5.0.2'). Replaces the first recording, tag v5.0.1 (87ab1f6ced28f75ba73ca899dc759b019310944a): 5.0.2 is what is installed and run, and its only functional change filters gold predictions to the requested instances (ADR 0009).
source.license: Evaluator: MIT. Dataset: no license declared in the HF card metadata; confirm before redistributing anything derived from it.

evaluation.upstreamEvaluator: swebench.harness.run_evaluation (per-instance Docker environments, per-repo log parsers, FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS)
evaluation.taskIdentity: instance_id kept verbatim. The agent produces a model_patch; scoring is done by the upstream evaluator on a predictions file.
evaluation.knownNonEquivalent: harness/src/task/loaders/swebench.mjs (harness import swebench) produces pytest approximations and marks them officialEvalCompatible:false. It must not be used for main-comparison scores.

openQuestions: Korean: the issues are English. Any Korean variant is a derived condition and must be reported separately (ADR 0003).
datasets.officialEvaluationCompatibility: upstream-compatible scoring: swebench.harness.run_evaluation on the sha256-verified parquet, official per-instance images (dataset `image` column) and log parsers; outcomes copied from the official report. Prediction generation (agent through upstage-cli) is this project's; prompt template recorded below.
datasets.publisher: SWE-bench team (Princeton/Stanford; Verified subset with OpenAI)

acquisition.method: benchmarks/swebench/acquire.py downloads the single parquet at the pinned revision into .cache/ (not committed) and verifies its sha256.
acquisition.metadataIndex: datasets/swe-bench-verified/index.json (ids, repos, base commits, versions, difficulty; no issue text, patches or tests)

subset.method: Repository-stratified: proportional allocation (largest remainder, >=1 per repository); within a repository, rank by sha256(seed + ':' + instance_id). Inputs: instance ids and repository names only.
subset.rationale: Resolve rate is reported per model on the same instances (paired). n=100 gives a worst-case 95% Wald half-width of 9.8 points for a single model; paired model differences are tested per instance (McNemar). Each instance is a full agent episode plus an evaluation container, so 100 bounds cost; the full 500 remain runnable.

datasets.transformation: Issue text wrapped in prompt template kab-swebench-prompt-v1 (harness/src/benchmarks/swebench.mjs; sha256 recorded in each run); hints_text not given; no other change. The agent works in the official instance image with network none. Patches are captured byte-exact against base_commit.
datasets.contextFeasibility: datasets/swe-bench-verified/context-feasibility-v1.json (preregistered; infeasible instances stay in the denominator)
datasets.contaminationRisk: Issues and fixes are public GitHub history (instance created_at 2013-01-25 to 2023-08-07); models trained after that may have seen them. Results are not presented as contamination-free.
datasets.redistribution: Evaluator: MIT. Dataset card declares no license: the parquet, issue texts and gold patches are not committed; only ids/metadata and our own artifacts.
resolvedQuestions: Context budget: resolved by ADR 0010 (upstage-cli b17a1f3, 23f8136, 802cddd: caller budget, observed calibration, exact /tokenize counting).
Agent envelope: frozen by ADR 0011 (30 turns, 60 tool calls, 2,700 s, English system prompt, 7 tools, concurrency 4).
